targets.query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't1_extracao_%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT task_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date)) / 60 as duration_minutes FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't1_extracao_%' AND execution_date = (SELECT MAX(execution_date) FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't1_extracao_%') ORDER BY duration_minutes DESC

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't2_silver_%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't3_gold_%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Data Quality - Row Counts by Layer (Last Run)

targets.query: SELECT CASE WHEN task_id LIKE 't1_%' THEN 'Bronze' WHEN task_id LIKE 't2_%' THEN 'Silver' WHEN task_id LIKE 't3_%' THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Other' END as layer, COUNT(*) as tasks_processed FROM task_instance WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date = (SELECT MAX(execution_date) FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander') GROUP BY layer

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE 't_sql_%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT execution_date, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date)) / 60 as duration_minutes FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'pipeline_corretora_santander' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 7
